text: Why don't these drugs work for everyone? Nobody knows for sure. This protocol tries something else. The ketone BHB blocks enzymes called HDACs (Shimazu, et al, 2013), and in mice that couldn't hold on to extinction learning (learning that a cue is now safe), an HDAC blocker made the new learning last (Whittle & Singewald, 2014). Whether ketosis does that in people hasn't been tested.
reader: someone with trauma or in withdrawal who is anxious, wired, numb or foggy, wanting to know what is going on in their brain and which of the protocol's tools does what

checked.point: SSRIs treat the "software" and cannot penetrate the "hardware"; ketones and HDAC inhibitors remodel the brain's structure
checked.found: paroxetine grew the hippocampus 4.6% in PTSD (Vermetten 2003), so SSRIs do change structure; BHB inhibits HDACs in mice (Shimazu 2013) and HDAC inhibitors made extinction last in mice (Whittle and Singewald 2014); nothing shows remodeling in people
